description: Defines the FuzzedSocket class, a mock socket implementation used for fuzz testing network responses, utilizing a FuzzedDataProvider to generate responses and simulate various network conditions.

classes.name: FuzzedSocket
classes.description: A mock socket class for fuzz testing network responses, capable of simulating various connection and data transfer errors using a FuzzedDataProvider.

methods.name: FuzzedSocket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the socket with a data provider and net log.

methods.name: set_fuzz_connect_result
methods.description: Configures whether the Connect() call should be fuzzed to succeed or fail.

methods.name: set_remote_address
methods.description: Sets the remote address the socket claims to be connected to.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs a read operation, generating data or errors based on the data provider.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a write operation, possibly succeeding or failing based on fuzzing logic.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the receive buffer.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the send buffer.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect the socket, possibly fuzzed to succeed or fail.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the socket.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log source.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the socket was ever used.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Indicates if ALPN was negotiated.

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL information.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for traffic annotation.
